__comment: OAuth2 replaces the dead username/password validator. customUI hosts the consent webview (like com.palm.eas / com.palm.skype); it loads OAuth2.buildAuthorizeUrl(), captures ?code= from the redirect to Config.REDIRECT_URI, then calls exchangeCode which returns the stored token credentials. DOCUMENTS-only: Google Photos is not reachable headlessly, so there is no PHOTO.UPLOAD provider.
__comment2: com.palm.app.cloud-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists (accounts/handlers/create.js -> Utils.hasPermission). Working templates (teams/telegram/skype) list their own auth app, not com.palm.app.accounts.
__comment3: com.palm.service.gdrive is in read+writePermissions so the service itself can readCredentials(accountId) for file ops and writeCredentials back after a token refresh (accounts/handlers/credentials.js checks these lists). Google does NOT rotate the refresh token, but the write path still runs when an access token is renewed.

capabilityProviders.__comment: The file-picker app consumes listFolder/downloadFile/uploadFile. Google-native docs (Docs/Sheets/Slides) are exported to Office/PDF on download; plain files transfer as-is. Not bound to the dead QuickOffice/Google-Docs proxy.
